price_note: Prices from the text menu at moxiealameda.com/menu (dinner, brunch, happy hour, drinks); hours combine the site's published windows (happy hour Wed-Sun 2pm-5pm, dinner Wed-Sun 5pm-9pm, brunch Sat-Sun 10am-2pm) and match the Instagram bio
flags: Operator's exact note: Alameda • Goods — but the site shows no shop, goods, or merchandise (only an empty Squarespace /cart link); it is a sit-down steakhouse
dietary marks (v, gf, vv) and the happy-hour 'Plates' / 'Bites' groupings are on the menu page and were not carried onto the rows

Name spelling varies: site title and homepage hero say 'Moxie Steak House' / 'MOXIE STEAK HOUSE' (two words), footer says just 'MOXIE', Instagram says 'MOXIE STEAKHOUSE' with handle moxiesteakhouse (one word)

Instagram mismatch: the site never mentions 'moxiesteakhouse'; its Squarespace social-link config points Instagram to instagram.com/littlehouse_cafe.moxie/ (the chef's former Little House café account, per the about page history); the 'moxiesteakhouse' handle is taken from the operator's screenshot of that profile, which links back to moxiealameda.com and shows the Park St address
Phone contradiction: site (homepage, footer, menu, about) lists (510) 671-2890; the Instagram Contact button (operator screenshot) lists (510) 864-4044
Email contradiction: site lists moxie1640@gmail.com; the Instagram Contact button lists tootsiepuplove@gmail.com
No ZIP code published anywhere on the site ('1640 Park Street Alameda Ca') or in the Instagram bio ('1640 Park St, Alameda, California')

Hours: the site footer on every page lists only 'Wednesday — Sunday 5pm — 9pm' (dinner); the homepage hero and menu page add Brunch Saturday & Sunday 10am-2pm and Happy Hour Wednesday-Sunday 2pm-5pm; the hours line combines these; Instagram bio 'Open 2 - 9 Wednesday - Friday, 10 - 9 Saturday- Sunday' agrees; Monday-Tuesday closure inferred from 'Open Wednesday-Sunday'
Market price item: 'Foolish Fish of the Day' is listed M/P with no price (Other Choices section)
Reservations page embeds a Squarespace Tock reservation block (no OpenTable/Resy link); menu page says no reservation needed for brunch
Menu text is seasonal ('Spring Asparagus Soup', 'Lemony Spring Slaw', blog post 'Spring Menu') and may be stale as of Sept 2026; prices recorded as currently published
Menu page lists non-alcoholic drinks twice with different spellings ('A'Siciliana Lemon Soda' vs 'A'siciliana Lemonata', 'San Pellegrino' vs 'San Pelligrino') and repeats 'Latte $5'

Two different marks: the site logo (logoImageUrl and og:image) is the teal fan/cocktail graphic fan.png, matching operator screenshot IMG_3772; the Instagram avatar is a vintage waitress illustration (IMG_3775)
About page names Donna Meadows as Executive Chef/owner and describes the room as 'reminiscent of an art-deco era French countryside restaurant and steakhouse'; site is Squarespace on its own domain
